title: Simplify the durable project implementation role
objective: Convert the durable project implementation-agent record from an OperatorRecord/CPN-specific instruction set into a concise stable production-implementation capability while preserving public-contract, source-documentation, scientific-integrity, ownership, and human-authority boundaries.
authorized_scope: The only project-agent target is `.pi/agents/ksdft2effmass-implementation.md`. The validated ownership manifest is `.pi/task-ownership/harness-simplification.agents.project-implementation.json`.

`ksdft2effmass-harness-implementation` owns the target agent record. `ksdft2effmass-harness-documentation` separately owns `docs/harness/ksdft2effmass.harness.010.030.020.md` and `docs/harness/ksdft2effmass.harness.001.050.000.md`. `ksdft2effmass-harness-integration-reviewer` performs one final read-only cross-surface review. The parent PI agent owns task and chain state, ownership integration, dispatch, handoff verification, deterministic validation, commit, push, and reporting.

The implementation role retains accepted-public-contract implementation and preservation, assigned-source docstrings, applicable DataObject/ResultObject/ActionObject/Workflow boundaries, explicit ownership, scientific and mathematical authority limits, fail-closed stop rules, and concise handoff reporting. Its durable skills are `design-data-action-objects` and `document-python-research-software`; subsystem-specific skills remain task-selected when supported by the control plane.
completion_criteria: Do not modify another project-agent record, durable harness-agent record, historical record, skill, harness implementation, test, scientific source, schema, fixture, dependency, lockfile, or retained evidence. Do not activate project-documentation, project-integration-review, project-architecture, live-discovery, historical-retirement, SQLite, or evidence-subsystem work. Do not reopen H0–H4.

Completion requires valid exact ownership, two writer handoffs, focused deterministic validation, one read-only integration review, at most one deterministic correction by the original owner, synchronized Sphinx-excluded documentation, and preservation of unrelated changes. On completion this task becomes completed, `active_task` returns to `null`, and every successor remains inactive; no automatic successor or checkpoint is created.
